label: Dual Blades
note: MH4U endgame Dual Blades use Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up L), Razor Sharp, and an element boost. Star Knight with Handicraft gems is the common accessible base (S+1, Razor Sharp via Steady Hand, Challenger +2) but lacks AuL; top mixed sets run Honed Blade with Razor Sharp plus Challenger +2, Evasion, HG Earplugs, or Weakness Exploit. Solo DBs match the monster's Fire/Water/Thunder/Ice/Dragon weakness; Blast and Paralysis are status options (Blast for general part damage, Paralysis for multiplayer), and Element Atk Up does not boost them. The model captures Honed Blade's S+1/AuL components and the 1.1x generic Element Atk Up; Razor Sharp, Honed Blade as a combined skill, Stamina, [Element] Atk +3 (1.15x plus flat element, usually stronger), Elemental/Status Crit, Challenger, Status Atk, Weakness Exploit, and Evasion/Earplugs are not modeled.
